scope.sourceTextMethod: Read every extracted full guide section, PDF144–271, from each sourcePdfPage through the page before the next control. Existing pdftotext output of the pinned PDF was read with horizontal whitespace normalized only; no source section was summarized before inspection. Two truncated output portions were reread in full (IR3.6.3/MA3.7.1 and CA3.12.1/CA3.12.2).

limitations: AI-assisted editorial comparison, not qualified human approval, certification, current applicability verification or a guarantee of 100% accuracy.
Official-host verification remains blocked/unresolved; the review uses the identified September2024 v2.13 guide snapshot.
All requested perspective fields were read; this full-field editorial pass is distinct from selected-field assessment-objective mappings and does not establish a complete instructional curriculum.
No factual correction identified means no correction identified during this bounded pass, not blanket approval. Technical jargon may still need contextual vocabulary and real learner testing.
Evidence examples are candidate materials for discussion, not exhaustive official evidence lists or proof of organizational compliance.
Current applicability has not been verified; this audit uses the pinned historical guide.

findings.issue: User reporting and communication are present, but role-appropriate incident-response training and assistance are absent from all fields although the Discussion explicitly includes them within user response. Add this teaching context without inventing a course or schedule.

findings.issue: Combines disposal and reuse before giving sanitize-or-destroy alternatives, which can imply destruction is an appropriate preparation for reuse. The two determination branches should be explicit in Beginner mode.
findings.proposedText: Before disposing of media containing CUI, sanitize it or destroy it. Sanitizing removes the information so it cannot be recovered. Before releasing media for reuse, sanitize it; simply deleting a file does not necessarily remove the information.
findings.sourceSupport: PDF169/printed161 objectives[a,b]: media is sanitized or destroyed before disposal; media is sanitized before release for reuse. PDF170/printed162 Further Discussion distinguishes destruction before disposal from cleaning/purging for reuse.
findings.reviewerProposedText: Before disposing of media containing CUI, sanitize or destroy it. Before releasing it for reuse, sanitize it. Removing a file from the screen does not necessarily remove the information from the media.
findings.coordinatingAdjustment: Explain sanitizing in plain language using the Discussion definition; preserve the disposal/reuse branches.
findings.resolution: Applied after coordinating comparison of the cited complete guide section; associated objective mappings re-compared and preserved.

findings.issue: Select sanitization or destruction before release leaves the destination distinction implicit. Preserve both objective branches in the technical explanation too.

The guide points to NIST SP 800-88 for sanitization methods. Consider embedded storage in printers and network equipment, as well as familiar drives and paper records.
